_: Every person named anywhere in this repository, declared.
The people-gate in check-leaks.mjs finds full names by shape and fails
on any that is not listed here. That is the whole mechanism: a name has
no format a pattern can recognise, so the only way to tell an invented
fixture from a real person is for somebody to have said which it is.
EVERY entry under `personas` is invented. If a real person's name is
ever the right answer, it does not go here -- it goes in an environment
variable, like the two addresses in seed.ts already do.
`notPeople` is for phrases the shape catches that are not names at all.
Each needs a reason; an unexplained entry is indistinguishable from a

notPeople.Aurora Global: A fictional customer organisation in D-49 / D-51's worked example of a multi-region tenant.
notPeople.Jay Stewart: The maintainer, named deliberately: a copyright notice is how a rights holder asserts rights, and the About page is the product's own 'who built this'. Not a fixture and not something to remove.
notPeople.Marco Antonio: The same — a compound given name.
notPeople.Mark María: Two adjacent fixture values read as one pair once the file is reflowed. Not a name anyone has.
notPeople.María José: A compound Spanish given name, not a first name and a surname.
notPeople.Mira Current: The fixture slug `mira-current` read as a name.
